title: DeepAgents: Minimal Agent
description: create_deep_agent with model, tools, and system_prompt; no explicit loop needed as the harness owns it.

steps.description: Minimal deep agent: tool, agent creation, and invoke with a multi-part question.
Imports: deepagents and langchain_core.tools for the tool decorator.
Tool: days_between with @tool decorator, type hints, docstring, and datetime logic.
Agent creation: create_deep_agent with ollama model, days_between tool, and scheduling assistant prompt.
Invocation: agent.invoke with messages dict containing the question, then print the last message content.
